---
applyTo: "**/*.ts, **/*.html"
---

# i18n Rules (ngx-translate)

> All user-visible text MUST use `@ngx-translate`. No hardcoded UI strings in templates or components.

## Setup

```typescript
// In standalone component imports:
import { TranslateModule } from "@ngx-translate/core";

@Component({
  standalone: true,
  imports: [TranslateModule],
})
```

## Template Usage

```html
<!-- Pipe (preferred in templates) -->
<span>{{ 'FEATURE.LABEL_KEY' | translate }}</span>

<!-- Directive (for attributes) -->
<button [attr.aria-label]="'FEATURE.CLOSE' | translate">...</button>

<!-- With parameters -->
<p>{{ 'FEATURE.WELCOME' | translate: { name: userName } }}</p>
```

## Component Usage

```typescript
import { TranslateService } from "@ngx-translate/core";

@Component({ ... })
export class MyComponent {
  private translate = inject(TranslateService);

  showMessage(): void {
    // Instant (key must exist) — use only when synchronous is required
    const msg = this.translate.instant("FEATURE.MESSAGE");
  }
}
```

## Key Naming Convention

Use `SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE`, scoped by feature then element:

```
FEATURE_NAME.SECTION.ELEMENT_DESCRIPTION
```

Examples:

```
DEMO.HOME.TITLE
DEMO.HOME.DESCRIPTION
NAV.MENU.SETTINGS
COMMON.ACTIONS.SAVE
COMMON.ACTIONS.CANCEL
COMMON.ERRORS.REQUIRED
```

## Translation Files

Add keys to **all** locale files when creating new ones:

- `src/assets/i18n/en-US.json`
- `src/assets/i18n/fr-FR.json`
- `src/assets/i18n/pt-PT.json`

```json
{
  "DEMO": {
    "HOME": {
      "TITLE": "Home",
      "DESCRIPTION": "Welcome to the demo"
    }
  }
}
```

## i18n Checklist

- [ ] No hardcoded user-visible text in templates or TS files
- [ ] New keys added to all 3 locale files (`en-US`, `fr-FR`, `pt-PT`)
- [ ] Key follows `FEATURE.SECTION.ELEMENT` naming convention
- [ ] `translate` pipe used in templates (not `instant()` unless sync required)
- [ ] Dynamic values passed as parameters, not concatenated strings
